method: 只读 text/ 素读，未开 md

facts.fact: 作者主张：2020 年代正成为她本人、母亲、祖母、曾祖母一生中所见女性权利萎缩最严重的单一十年。
facts.quote: the 2020s are shaping up to be the greatest single decade in the atrophy of women’s rights in my lifetime or, for that matter, in the lifetimes of my mother, grandmothers, or great-grandmothers.

facts.fact: Annie 因怀孕时试图杀死胎儿 Peter 而成为「Monstrous Bitch #1」；其母 Ellen 则过度介入她的两次怀孕、充当恶毒代理母亲夺走 Charlie（#2）。
facts.quote: So Annie comes across as Monstrous Bitch #1 (trying to kill a baby in utero), while her mother comes across as Monstrous Bitch #2 (in that she was overinvolved in the pregnancies, in a way that terrified Annie, and functioned as a malicious surrogate mother, sidelining Annie herself).

facts.fact: Charlie 在派对上误食坚果、喉咙闭合，而 Annie 明知她坚果过敏仍逼 Peter 带她去且没给 EpiPen，Peter 送医途中她被电话杆斩首。
facts.quote: Charlie eats nuts in some cake at the party; her throat starts to close; this unleashes a sequence of events that result in her being decapitated by a phone pole as Peter desperately tries to drive her to a hospital.

facts.fact: 终场 Joan 对被 Charlie 灵魂附身的 Peter 宣布「你是 Paimon，地狱八王之一」，并说已「修正」其原先的女性身体、给他健康的男性宿主。
facts.quote: So, third, in the final scene, as Peter is becoming possessed by Charlie’s resurrected spirit, Joan addresses him/her, saying, “Charlie, it’s all right now. You are Paimon, one of the eight kings of hell.… We’ve corrected your first female body, and give you now this healthy, male host.”

facts.fact: 《The Substance》(2024) 把「年老的 Elisabeth」（Demi Moore）与她的年轻分身、由 Margaret Qualley 饰演并取名 Sue 的那一半，在身体上彻底分开。
facts.quote: The Substance physically segregates the “old” Elisabeth (Moore) from her “young” counterpart, who takes the name of Sue and is played by Margaret Qualley.

facts.fact: 影片把由无数不同的 Elisabeth 捣碎粘合而成的那具令人作呕的嵌合怪物命名为 Elisasue。
facts.quote: This monster, whom the film names Elisasue, is truly, deeply revolting, in large part because she is composite—made of many, many different Elisabeths, all smashed together in a disgusting chimeric body.

facts.fact: 本章转折点：作者从 2018／2024 两部恐怖片转向「很久很久以前」，主张在 Monstrous Bitch 主导之前、文字发明后不久，还存在另一个强大女性原型（下段点名 Inanna）。
facts.quote: Because there was a time, long, long ago, before the Monstrous Bitch had come to dominate the patriarchal depiction of powerful women, when the Patriarchy’s stranglehold on Western culture was less, well, strangulating—a time not long after writing had been invented, when the Monstrous Bitch was in circulation along with another powerful female archetype.

facts.fact: 约四千三百年前萨尔贡王（King Sargon）在美索不达米亚掌权，其女 Enheduanna 是女祭司、作家，也是史上第一位留下姓名的作者。
facts.quote: About forty-three hundred years ago, King Sargon came to power in Mesopotamia. Sargon had a daughter named Enheduanna. She was a brilliant, powerful woman, a sacred priestess, socially respected, and a magnificent writer. She is also the first named author in history.
